items.source:
-- HUDLayout · Posiciona los elementos del HUD en runtime (S1).
-- El layout NO se escribe por bridge: la codificación UDim2 en JSON no está
-- verificada en el protocolo (cero invención, Plan §0). Aquí es Luau puro.
local gui = script.Parent
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local remotes = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("Remotes")
local deliveryState = remotes:WaitForChild("DeliveryState")

local function layout(name, anchor, pos, size)
	local el = gui:FindFirstChild(name, true)
	if el and el:IsA("GuiObject") then
		el.AnchorPoint = anchor
		el.Position = pos
		el.Size = size
	end
end

-- Timer: arriba al centro
layout("TimerLabel", Vector2.new(0.5, 0), UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 12), UDim2.new(0, 140, 0, 56))

-- Tarjeta de paquete: centro-izquierda
layout("PackageCard", Vector2.new(0, 0.5), UDim2.new(0, 16, 0.5, 0), UDim2.new(0, 220, 0, 150))
layout("CardIcon", Vector2.new(0.5, 0), UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 8), UDim2.new(0, 48, 0, 48))
layout("CardTitle", Vector2.new(0.5, 0), UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 58), UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 26))
layout("CardModifier", Vector2.new(0.5, 0), UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 88), UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 24))
layout("CardDestination", Vector2.new(0.5, 0), UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 116), UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 26))

-- Barra de estabilidad: abajo al centro
layout("StabilityBar", Vector2.new(0.5, 1), UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -90), UDim2.new(0, 320, 0, 22))
layout("Fill", Vector2.new(0, 0.5), UDim2.new(0, 2, 0.5, 0), UDim2.new(1, -4, 1, -4))
layout("Label", Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0), UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0))

-- Brújula de destino: bajo el timer
layout("DestinationArrow", Vector2.new(0.5, 0), UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 76), UDim2.new(0, 360, 0, 30))

-- Panel de resultado: centro
layout("ResultPanel", Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0), UDim2.new(0, 340, 0, 190))
layout("ResultTitle", Vector2.new(0.5, 0), UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 12), UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 34))
layout("ResultBreakdown", Vector2.new(0.5, 0), UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 52), UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 90))
layout("ResultCoins", Vector2.new(0.5, 1), UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -44), UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 32))

-- Coins: arriba a la derecha
layout("CoinsLabel", Vector2.new(1, 0), UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 12), UDim2.new(0, 160, 0, 34))

local timerLabel = gui:FindFirstChild("TimerLabel", true)
local packageCard = gui:FindFirstChild("PackageCard", true)
local destinationArrow = gui:FindFirstChild("DestinationArrow", true)
local resultPanel = gui:FindFirstChild("ResultPanel", true)
local coinsLabel = gui:FindFirstChild("CoinsLabel", true)

local function setText(name, value)
	local element = gui:FindFirstChild(name, true)
	if element and element:IsA("TextLabel") then
		element.Text = value
	end
end

local function setVisible(element, visible)
	if element and element:IsA("GuiObject") then
		element.Visible = visible
	end
end

deliveryState.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(state)
	local stateName = state.State
	local seconds = state.Seconds or 0
	setVisible(packageCard, stateName == "Available" or stateName == "Active" or stateName == "Tick")
	setVisible(destinationArrow, stateName == "Active" or stateName == "Tick")
	setVisible(resultPanel, stateName == "Success" or stateName == "Failed")
	if timerLabel and timerLabel:IsA("TextLabel") then
		timerLabel.Visible = stateName == "Active" or stateName == "Tick"
		timerLabel.Text = ("%02d SEC"):format(seconds)
	end
	setText("CardTitle", ("PACKAGE #%d"):format(state.PackageNumber or 0))
	setText("CardModifier", if stateName == "Available" then "SELECCIONA PAQUETE EN HQ" else "NORMAL")
	setText("CardDestination", "DESTINO: " .. (state.Destination or ""))
	setText("DestinationArrow", "DESTINO: " .. (state.Destination or ""))
	if coinsLabel and coinsLabel:IsA("TextLabel") then
		coinsLabel.Text = ("COINS: %d"):format(state.Coins or 0)
	end
	if stateName == "Success" then
		setText("ResultTitle", "DELIVERY SUCCESS")
		setText("ResultBreakdown", ("TIME BONUS +$%d"):format(seconds))
		setText("ResultCoins", ("+$%d"):format(state.Reward or 0))
	elseif stateName == "Failed" then
		setText("ResultTitle", "DELIVERY FAILED")
		setText("ResultBreakdown", "TIME RAN OUT")
		setText("ResultCoins", "+$0")
	end
	if resultPanel and resultPanel:IsA("GuiObject") and (stateName == "Success" or stateName == "Failed") then
		resultPanel.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.42, 0)
		TweenService:Create(
			resultPanel,
			TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
			{ Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0) }
		):Play()
	end
end)

print("[Delivery60] HUDLayout listo")
